BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing medicaid expansion; adding a newsection to chapter 74.09 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the federalpatient protection and affordable care act provides an opportunity toexpand medicaid to adults with incomes below one hundred thirtythreepercent of the federal poverty level, as defined in the social securityact section 1902(a)(10)(A)(i)(VIII). The federal law establishes theeligibility requirements and benefit requirements for the medicaidexpansion to align with the subsidized coverage options that will beavailable through the health benefit exchange and provide a continuumof coverage options for lowincome individuals.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The authority is authorized to implement the medicaid expansiondefined in section 1902(a)(10)(A)(i)(VIII) of the federal social p. 1 SSB 5876security act, consistent with budget authorization provided in theomnibus appropriations act.
